title: ALP Platform Curriculum Export v1
description: Platform-produced description of one or more Learning Targets' structure, consumed by a Curriculum Reader (Q37). Every item is a declared-stable platform identifier; ALP treats all IDs and kinds as opaque strings and never parses platform-native content.

platform.description: Platform identifier; must match the reading adapter.

contentHash.description: Platform-computed hash of the target's content; changes whenever content changes.

phases.description: Ordered groupings of the target's items.

items.description: Declared-stable items in curriculum order. A child item references a parent declared earlier; a top-level item names its phase.

id.description: Opaque item ID, unique within the target.

kind.description: Platform item kind; must be one the adapter declares stable.

mapping.description: Platform-owned content-to-competency mapping for this target; absent when the target is unmapped.
